objective: Patch DAFoam so KSPSetFromOptions is honoured instead of overridden, regression-control the patch against the shipped build, and then apply to the rung-3 wall the one class of remedy the whole A3 campaign proved unreachable
rationale: The A3 investigation closed with ten candidate causes eliminated by measurement and a precisely-bounded residue. Every one of those ten was a REACHABLE lever. The class that the diagnosis actually pointed to - a two-level or coarse-space preconditioner, a field-split, an augmented-restart Krylov method - was never tested, because DALinearEqn.C calls KSPSetFromOptions at line 138 and then overrides ksp_type, pc_type and sub_pc_type at twelve call sites afterwards, so PETSc's standard escape hatch is dead (defect candidate f29378d9). That defect is filed as filing-ready with three graded fixes and the chief has flagged that nobody has costed them. This item costs them by implementing the best one, and the same patch simultaneously unlocks the only untested remedy class for the unexplained residue. Three products from one arm: a costed and tested fix that upgrades the upstream submission from a proposal into a patch with regression evidence, the first test of the previously-unreachable remedy class at rung 3, and either an eleventh eliminated candidate or the ceiling's mechanism
gate: Stage 1 (the decisive one): patch DALinearEqn.C so KSPSetFromOptions is called LAST - daOptions become defaults, runtime options become overrides, which is what both APIs promise - rebuild the three AD targets, and prove two things. Regression: the patched image with no PETSC_OPTIONS set must reproduce rung 1's converged arm BIT-IDENTICALLY (CD 368 / CL 383 iterations, reason 2), which is the family's R11 discipline for a patched build. Restoration: a run with PETSC_OPTIONS=-ksp_type fgmres -ksp_view must print type: fgmres where the shipped build prints type: gmres. Either proof failing ends the item there and is reported. Stage 2, only if stage 1 passes: apply the previously-unreachable remedies to the rung-3 wall (lgmres or dgmres for augmented restarting, gamg, fieldsplit, sub_pc_type lu), each graded against the standing control - the fill-0 diagnostic's residual 1.615428631404e-02 at iteration 400 - under the same 10x materiality bar the fill-1 arm used. Outcome one: a previously-unreachable remedy converges rung 3, the ceiling gains the mechanism the campaign could not reach and the upstream defect gains its strongest possible motivation. Outcome two: none does, the elimination table gains its eleventh entry, and the ceiling hardens further with the honest note that the unreachable class is now reachable and still does not clear it
cost_basis: measured, from the lab's own prior patched rebuild of this exact file: W4_ADJOINT_PC_UNBLOCK.md section 4 records the subpclu patch of DALinearEqn.C at about 40 s of compile per target and about 2 min of container CPU across all three wmake targets, with the recipe and its documented pitfall (source the OpenFOAM environment before set -e). Stage 1 is therefore about 5 core-min of build plus rung 1's own measured converged arm at 7.33 core-min as the regression control, plus a seconds-long ksp_view proof: about 15 core-min total. Stage 2 is priced separately from the rung-3 diagnostic's measured 25.9 core-min per 400-iteration arm and is NOT requested here
expected_knowledge_gain: Either PETSc's escape hatch is restored and the first-ever test of coarse-space, field-split and augmented-restart remedies on this operator becomes possible - which is the only untested class left against the residue - or the patch does not behave and the defect report gains a measured caveat about its own recommended fix. The regression control also answers, for the upstream submission, whether honouring KSPSetFromOptions is behaviour-neutral by default, which is the first question any maintainer will ask

launch_prompt: Restore the KSP options escape hatch. Read DEFECT_CANDIDATE_ksp_options_override.md and W4_ADJOINT_PC_UNBLOCK.md section 4 first. Stage 1 only unless stage 2 is separately approved: patch DALinearEqn.C to call KSPSetFromOptions last, rebuild the three AD targets per the recorded recipe, commit the patch beside the subpclu one, then prove regression (rung 1 converged arm bit-identical, CD 368 / CL 383, env clean) and restoration (-ksp_type fgmres visible in -ksp_view). Pre-register both proofs before compute; a failure of either ends the item and is reported as a caveat on the defect report's own recommended fix. R11 discipline: the shipped-toolchain verdict stands unchanged and the patched result is recorded beside it, never in place of it
decision_note: chosen by the DAFoam solver agent under the standing directive as the highest-value next work in the family, priced from a measured basis and filed for the chief before any spend above the ~10 core-min threshold
